rules.name: npm cache
rules.description: Downloaded npm packages. Projects keep working; the next install downloads packages again.

rules.name: Yarn cache
rules.description: Downloaded Yarn packages. The next install downloads packages again.

rules.name: pip cache
rules.description: Downloaded Python packages and built wheels. The next install downloads them again.

rules.name: NuGet HTTP cache
rules.description: Cached NuGet feed responses and package downloads. Restored projects are not affected.

rules.name: NuGet global packages
rules.description: Extracted NuGet packages used by .NET builds. The next build restores them from the internet.

rules.name: Gradle caches
rules.description: Downloaded dependencies and build caches of Gradle. The next build downloads them again.

rules.name: Maven local repository
rules.description: Downloaded Maven artifacts. The next build downloads them again.

rules.name: Cargo registry cache
rules.description: Downloaded Rust crate archives. The next build downloads them again.

rules.name: Go build cache
rules.description: Compiled Go packages. Rebuilt automatically on the next build.
